author: IcyCode
body:
Hey all,
Back around Julyish last year there was a map event organised by Para & Evo (only 2 map devs at the time). I really think they should put another one on as it really was great fun and loads of people joined in. I know it probably took quite a bit of organising but now you have 4X as many map devs as back then. Anyway just a suggestion for a great community event and a way to test a load of maps.
Leave feedback/suggestions for it below :D
